sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "email" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "properties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "address_line1" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address_line2" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "city" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "region" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "postal_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "country" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "landlord_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "lease_start" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "property_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES properties (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "baseline_inspection_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inspections (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "last_package_export_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inspections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_key" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "baseline_room_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "checklist_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "not_applicable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("not_applicable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_evidence" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "checklist_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES checklist_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "preview_path" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "source_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "exif_date_time_original" TEXT NULL, "exif_make" TEXT NULL, "exif_model" TEXT NULL, "original_has_gps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("original_has_gps" IN (0, 1)), "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "caption" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evidence_hashes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_evidence (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "algorithm" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SHA-256', "hex_digest" TEXT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "issues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "media_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES media_evidence (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "annotations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_evidence (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "issue_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES issues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "x" REAL NOT NULL, "y" REAL NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inspections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issue_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "includes_comparison" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("includes_comparison" IN (0, 1)), "generated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_to_landlord_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "room_comparisons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "verdict" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("room_id"));
